description: This file defines the ApiService interface for fetching show data in various categories, along with a stub implementation returning empty lists.

classes.name: StubApiService
classes.description: A stub implementation of ApiService that returns empty lists for all category fetch methods.

methods.name: getTrending
methods.description: Fetches trending shows, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: getContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches shows the user is continuing to watch, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Fetches action genre shows, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: getDrama
methods.description: Fetches drama genre shows, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: getHorror
methods.description: Fetches horror genre shows, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: getFamily
methods.description: Fetches family genre shows, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: getComedy
methods.description: Fetches comedy genre shows, returns a list of ShowDto.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ApiService which by default returns a stub.
